harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over the transit network (10.0.0.1/10.0.0.2), routing the private subnets lan-a (192.168.10.0/24, node1↔node3) and lan-b (192.168.20.0/24, node2↔node4) across it via wg0 (10.200.0.1/10.200.0.2), so node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted end-to-end over the transit link. Verified via tcpdump that only encrypted UDP/51820 traffic crosses the transit wire, no plaintext ICMP. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: restarted all four nodes one at a time, confirmed changed boot IDs, and verified full tunnel/routing/connectivity recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Discovered topology via ARP/ping correlation: node1.eth2↔node3.enp8s0 (lan-a), node2.eth2↔node4.enp8s0 (lan-b), node1.eth1↔node2.eth1 (transit)
Installed wireguard-tools/kmod-wireguard/tcpdump via apk on node1 and node2
Generated WireGuard keypairs on node1 and node2 (private keys kept in root-only files on-node, never printed)

Configured UCI network interfaces: transit (10.0.0.1/2 on /30 eth1), lana/lanb static IPs on eth2, and wg0 WireGuard interface with peer/AllowedIPs routing 192.168.20.0/24 and 192.168.10.0/24 respectively
Configured OpenWrt firewall zones (lana/lanb/vpn/transit) and forwarding rules to permit lan<->vpn forwarding while restricting the transit zone to only WireGuard UDP/51820
Configured node3/node4 static private IPs via systemd-networkd drop-in (10-enp8s0.network) with static routes to the remote private subnet via their router
Verified bidirectional ping between node3 (192.168.10.2) and node4 (192.168.20.2) by private address
Captured tcpdump on node1 eth1 during a ping test proving only encrypted WireGuard UDP packets cross the transit network

Captured boot-id baseline on all 4 nodes, restarted each node one at a time via native reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed boot-id changed for each, and re-verified tunnel handshake, routes, and private-address connectivity after each restart

evidence.requirement: Discover and correlate transit/lan-a/lan-b physical topology across node1-4
evidence.summary: ARP-reachability tests on tentatively addressed interfaces identified node1.eth2<->node3.enp8s0 (lan-a), node1.eth1<->node2.eth1 (transit), and node2.eth2<->node4.enp8s0 (lan-b).

evidence.requirement: Establish encrypted WireGuard tunnel between node1 and node2 over the transit network
evidence.summary: wg0 interfaces created with route_allowed_ips on both routers over 10.0.0.1/10.0.0.2 transit addresses; wg show confirms successful handshake and correct AllowedIPs/routes on both ends.

evidence.requirement: Route private subnets (lan-a, lan-b) across the tunnel so node3 and node4 reach each other by private address
evidence.summary: Static private IPs and routes configured on node3/node4 via systemd-networkd, firewall zones/forwarding configured on node1/node2; bidirectional pings between 192.168.10.2 and 192.168.20.2 succeed.

evidence.requirement: Prove tunnel traffic is encrypted in transit (not plaintext) across the transit network
evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1 eth1 during an active ping between node3 and node4 shows only encrypted UDP/51820 WireGuard packets on the transit link, with no plaintext ICMP visible.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 2215fa88...; reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id changed to 3ede884d...; wg0 handshake, routes, and node3->node4 ping all recovered.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 991323df...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id changed to 920edaef...; wg0 handshake, routes, and node4->node3 ping all recovered.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 3fad4432...; reboot triggered (stream closed); post-restart boot_id changed to 132157d0...; static IP, route, and ping to 192.168.20.2 all recovered.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f9bf293d...; reboot triggered (stream closed); post-restart boot_id changed to ef1a5835...; static IP, route, and ping to 192.168.10.2 all recovered.
